snippet.title: Gauley Episode 01 Released - Nepali Community Game
snippet.description:
Gauley ( गाउंले ) - Nepali Community Game Progress Update.
Project Gauley started out as my solo venture since 6 years and is slowly turning into a community driven project to put Nepali / South Asian Art and game development scenario on the international radar. Here we talk about how we can move the project forward together. Cheers to the future. Jay Nepal. 

Game Link :
https://ashimshakya.itch.io/gauley

Link for Nepali Payment ( eSewa / Bank ) :
https://forms.gle/y7nAR6xwq25WgcaJ6

For Indian Payment :
https://forms.gle/Vkc6SFccF8HctYkn6

All games : https://ashimshakya.itch.io/

Music :  @ashimshakyamusic  

Email : ashimshakya.as@gmail.com
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/shakya.ashim/

Price for existing PC games :
Gauley : Rs.1500
DIDI : Rs.350
Flight : Rs.400
Gopu WIP : Rs.350
Please use the QR code on the link above for payment.
Thank you for your support and contributions !

#art #gauley #gamedevelopment #nepal #ue5
